features: 1TOPS AI computing power with multi-algorithm switchover
Person detection, target attribute recognition, target enhancement
License plate recognition (Chinese Mainland plates), vehicle color/type/model recognition
Behavior analysis: fast movement, tripwire crossing, intrusion, area entry/exit, loitering
Crowd flow analysis: queue length, head counting, crowd flow statistics
Traffic flow statistics: motor vehicle / non-motorized vehicle / pedestrian
Defogging and EIS (electronic image stabilization, sensitivity levels not supported)
2 alarm inputs, 1 alarm output; RS-485 serial port
Media stream encryption (up to 2 channels), video and image digital watermark
Open OS / SDK / REST API / GB/T 28181 / GA/T 1400 open ecosystem
4kV surge protection, Class C corrosion resistance
release_notes: Video frame rate is stated as '25 or 20 fps (configurable)' without specifying which is default; 25 fps recorded as primary. Power consumption stated as maximum 12W, typical 4.5W; maximum recorded.
